turns.q: Any discount if I add a second smaller item?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, absolutely! When our Buy 1 Get 1 Free (B1G1) promotion is active, adding a second item means the automated checkout system pairs your items together. You are charged for the higher-priced piece, and the item of equal or lesser value is discounted to free. 🙂
